cases.name: the demo's stylesheet is dropped from SHEETS
caught_by: a stylesheet whose every selector is used passes
a class no page or script names is reported
an id no page or script names is reported
a class named only inside a CSS comment is not treated as defined
a class only ever built dynamically still counts as used
the docs pages count as sources
the generated wasm glue is not a source
a dead class in the demo's own stylesheet is reported

cases.name: the sheets share one pooled corpus instead of their own sources
cases.new: files = [f for _, g in SHEETS for f in sources(root, g)]
caught_by: a demo class named only by a site page is still dead
a stylesheet with no sources at all is reported, not passed

cases.name: a sheet with no sources is not reported
cases.old: record(f"{sheet} has sources to check against", bool(files), str(globs))
cases.new: record(f"{sheet} has sources to check against", True, str(globs))
caught_by: a stylesheet with no sources at all is reported, not passed
